decisions.reason: The source counts connectors on the main board and does not change the power-board USB-C connector's type, data lines, or sourceability requirements.
Adding a main-board connector count does not change the power sources, diode OR-ing method, or source-selection behavior.
The source concerns the main-board connector inventory and does not resolve or alter the power-board battery connector's pinout, placement, family, or mounting style.
The total JST count and general statement that most connectors have low pin counts do not change any specific panel connector, control mapping, or mounting requirement.
The main-board connector count does not affect the power board's dimensions, mounting holes, enclosure fit, or connector arrangement.
Confirming one additional on-board USB-C connector does not change its standalone-power activation condition, LDO capacity, or powered scope.
The source does not identify or change the charge-status connector, LED chain, GPIO, resistor values, or population settings.
Connector quantities and a general pin-count characteristic do not change any ESP32 GPIO assignment.
The connector inventory update does not alter the requirement for local decoupling capacitors.
The source only specifies connector inventory and does not change the INA219 or the rail it monitors.
The connector count does not change the addressable LEDs' supply voltage, switching, or data-level shifting.
The main-board connector inventory does not change the I2C series-resistor value, placement, purpose, or population policy.
